positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Skills: Clojure · Clojurescript · React.js · Aurora · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborate with Agile team to continuously develop, test and deploy production-quality features using React, Node, AWS Lambda, and Python

Designed and refactored new reporting microservice that is a core feature to the software and helped secure company’s first international customer

Communicate directly with integrated partners to develop multiple NodeJS REST APIs that were documented using Swagger

Collaborate with UI/UX engineers to perform usability tests with clients, leading to improved efficiency and usability of application

Handle continuous deployment to QA, UAT, and Prod environments with Jenkins, Docker, and Rancher

Introduced and currently lead new agile ceremonies and testing strategies which saw a dramatic performance increase in sprint completion rate

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Built multi-threaded showcase application using Python, C, and PyQt that serves as the primary factor in demonstrating new IoT software and securing client sales

Showcase uses Serial communication between Arduino microcontroller and Raspberry Pi to send data to cloud via RESTful/MQTT APIs

Worked directly with VP of Engineering to build water sensor demo using C-programmed microcontrollers and Lantronix XPort devices, which was used at 2018 Sensor Expo

positions.title: IT and Software Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Created Slack Bot that remotely processes commands through Slack application to control TV functionalities for all screens in the building
•	Improved both efficiency and ease of content management by installing Raspberry Pis throughout building televisions to display and change graphics, videos, and information
•	Designed and coded webpages to automate and display event, date, time and other information throughout building
•	Assist staff and entrepreneurs with various technical and computer issues throughout the building
•	Set up database and PHP-based search page to allow for ease of video recording searches
•	Provided AV support during events
•	Set up and installed various computers, cameras, VR equipment and printers

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
•	Maintained retiree database containing contact info, address, and private information for all retirees
•	Managed Wordpress-based website for the center
•	Wrote Python scripts to automate searches
•	Created event flyers and newsletters to be electronically sent out and mailed
•	Created ID cards for retirees
•	Communicated with staff, alumni, and retirees to help set up events for retirees

positions.title: Cashier/Cook
positions.description:
•	Seasonal employment at the Orange County Fairgrounds
•	Provided exceptional customer service to handle customer orders and requests
•	Prepared popcorn, crepes, and tempura to be served to fair attendees
•	Sold popcorn in concert stands to show attendees
•	Prepped ingredients before opening and responsible for shutting down and cleaning up stand after closing

projects.title: The Fridge App
projects.description:
●	Shared fridge mobile app that allows housemates to keep track of the contents in their fridge. Users can view who each item belongs to, get notified when food is expiring, and request items belonging to other housemates.
●	Front-end uses React-Native and AsyncStorage to store user sessions for persistent login
●	Back-end uses Express middleware to handle requests and perform CRUD operations on MongoDB database

projects.title: L-Zip Program
projects.description: Program that compresses and decompresses a file using Lempel-Ziv compression method.
